title: The Bhonsles
definition: The Bhonsles were a prominent Maratha clan of Kshatriya status who rose from local Deshmukhs in the Deccan to establish a sovereign empire, fundamentally altering the political landscape of 17th and 18th-century India.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the transition from Mughal-Deccan Sultanate hegemony to the Maratha Confederacy, state-building, and administrative evolution in Medieval India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Bhonsles.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
